title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Eternal: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "I always thought there'd be more to the ooze."
"We choose what holds us back."
They're the world's most fearsome fighting team!
"You've gotta give it your all because anything less won't get the job done."
"This is great! I must really be onto something hot if they're trying to kill me!"
paragraphs.card: April O'Neil, Live on the Scene

paragraphs.text: "What am I? I am nothing anymore! A FREAK! I'll never be taken seriously as a scientist again!"
"Give me a recap. Are we winning or losing?"
"I'm not trying to cause trouble. Trouble just follows me around."
"I am Krang, the All-Powerful! I have never been defeated!"
"I've beaten this turtle already. This is no test." —Karai
"Every chessboard requires pawns. Tonight, my pawn, I'll find out just how strong you are."
"My patience wears thin!"
The streets are a dangerous place for a pair of neon nightriders.
"The stakes have risen, my green friends. Now you are playing for the fate of the world!"
"They're not stupid. They're infants." —Professor Jordan Perry
Victory comes in endless forms.
She's a thousand pounds of punishing reptile muscle, with the bite to back it up.
The pizza that vanishes quickly without a trace.
"Just gotta hit 'em harder than they hit you!"
From the golden age of gaming . . .
Nowhere else can one coin buy you a second chance.
"Good news, dudes! It says it's inflammable!" —Michelangelo
"All the best comic books start in dark alleys." —Michelangelo
Between ninjas, mutants, and alien bases, the subterranean housing market is shockingly competitive.
One lean, mean, green, incredible team.
"Ninja master, meet derby queen!" —April O'Neil
"Thanks to its increased density, water flowing at just seven miles per hour carries the same kinetic energy as an F5 tornado . . . which is to say: Hold on tight, guys!" —Donatello
It was a blunt metaphor: No legacies. No past. From here, the Turtles must choose to live in the present. Or not at all.
"He's more mutagen than mutant!" —Donatello
"One need not always find peace on the sword's edge, my son. One can find peace as readily in helping things grow." —Splinter
"Yo! It's the green machine! / Gonna rock the town without bein' seen! / Have you ever seen a turtle get doooown?"
"Slash was too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let him rest in peace . . . Even if the knockoffs proved temperamental."
"Who are these . . . freaks? How do they know to fight like that? Answer me, or hang here until you die."
"Fear. Feed. Stronger. Spread my spawn."
The power to draw on the wisdom of your allies at any time, from any place . . . or trade cat pics!
The Time Scepter can not only control time, but bend reality itself. Its master could rule all of reality, rewriting history to suit their whims.
Antonio's accommodated every request, asked no questions, and stayed open late. Truly a light in the darkness.
Many interstellar civilizations have dumped their unwanted elements on Planet Morbus, from toxins to lowlifes.
Bury my shell on the lone prairie . . .
It's like the future's a party that these brothers just crashed . . .
Back in the '80s, Channel 6 built their headquarters at the corner of Spectacle and Scandal.
What began with a deafening roar ends in uncertain silence . . .

"A hamster sumo wrestler? Snot that's also a crime lord? An alien newt assassin? April, how am I supposed to edit all of this footage into something watchable, much less believable?" —Irma Langenstein
"Yooo, Rock, check that out. A *mutant* music club?" —Bebop
"You have traveled from the multitude of diverse universes, and I bid you welcome to the Battle Nexus Tournament." —Daimyo
The 79th dimension of Null-Time—the one the Time Masters call home—is the most stable. Ironically, it is lost to time whether they settled there because of that stability or if they made it so.
"This doesn't report weather. It makes weather! It's Krang's own design. Fair with high clouds . . . mild showers . . . Aha, TOTAL CHAOS!" —General Traag
Cruel fate shattered their homeworld into asteroids, with only traces of life preserved beneath emergency shelters. The Triceraton Republic fully intends to make that everyone else's problem . . .
Using their stolen Time Scepter—with total command of time and space—Bebop and Rocksteady departed for Prehistoric Earth in search of "somethin' big ta wrassle."
"Dis river, she dangerous. Not clean and safe like your sewers back home, ya?" —Leatherhead
The strange nature of Dimension X allows any and every microhabitat to flourish, from planet-sized eyes to an asteroid-top jungle paradise.
"The Caribbean in 1530? Rad! Pirates are totally cold! Is that what you say in your time? Or tepid? Cool? Anyway, the Time Scepter says Bebop and Rocksteady should be here somewhere." —Renet
"Lookit 'em, Rock. So quiet and content. Dey don't even know they're in a box fer other people ta gawk at. What a buncha dopes." —Bebop
"My preservation was a spectacle. Artificial empathy to salve the crushing despair of modern human society. Fool's compassion." —Ray Fillet
"Not remember good, papa, but . . . miss home. Miss friend." —Tokka

"Welcome, wrestling fans, to Stump Asteroid: Home of Stump Arena and the Intergalactic Wrestling Federation! Tonight we welcome new tag-team challengers! They're lean! They're mean! They're green . . ."
"You are here because the outside world rejects you. The Foot is your family. I am your father." —Shredder
"Where do you want to go? Jungle level? Ice level? Lava level? They have all the classics!" —Donatello
Nothing a New Yorker ain't seen a thousand times before.
Strike with swiftness. Strike with purpose. Strike true.
"Push yourself beyond your limits, to a place where there are no limits!"
Leonardo may have been a goody two-toes and the butt of every joke, but he was also the one they turned to when it was time to put the jokes away.
Once every decade, Splinter returns to the Battle Nexus. He fights not for glory, but to honor an old friend.
"I am meant to be the Triceraton Regenta, so I must fulfill my destiny and avenge my mother's death!" —Seri
"A tool need not be complex to be efficient."
"If you steal mutagen that doesn't exist from aliens that also don't exist, it's not really theft. More like creative writing!"
"What else can we do? No prison could hold Tokka, and she'll hurt someone if we let her out to play."
Now it is the shell who does the shocking.
The utrom are a peace-minded people, up to a point. Beyond that, they are a laser-minded people.
"Two minutes for slashing, two minutes for hooking, and my personal favorite, two minutes for high-sticking."
"Yes! It knows how to destroy! My secret concern is, does it know how to obey?" —Krang
"How about a five-minute game misconduct for roughing, pal?"
"Why does everyone have such a hard time believing I'm a good guy?"
Raphael loves this stuff. There's a flash as his shuriken come out. The toughs don't even see that. Too bad.
"I can take it!" —Raphael
"Wilcox said a weed is but an unloved flower, but this is the kind of flower only his mother could love!" —Donatello
"Being surrounded by a little chaos is normally my little happy place, but . . ."
"Dinobunga!" —Michelangelo
"Well, this is *like* meditating . . ." —Michelangelo
A good view isn't about location. It's about perspective.
"Esposito, my liege, grant me the flavor I am due." —Splinter, the Nibblemancer
Devoured by the turtle community.
Every pizza is some teenager's prey.
Raphael had no second thoughts about the supreme edict. He'd left text messages warning of the concoction, even though there was no service.
Not all edible things are fragile.
